title: Sửa gọn 2 lỗi Launcher & Xác thực Vòng đời Tiến trình

L1_powershell_5_1_compatibility.details: Replaced ArgumentList.Add() with Format-NativeArgument quoting joined into Arguments property; direct assignment to EnvironmentVariables; preserved UTF-8 BOM encoding on .ps1 files; avoided read-only $PID clash.

L2_startup_failure_cleanup.details: Progressive ownership tracking saved immediately after each resource spawn; try/catch block terminates created resources in reverse order by verified PID/StartTime/ExecutablePath identity; fail-closed preservation of state if cleanup incomplete.

pipe_inheritance_decoupling.details: Redirected child services stdout/stderr to dedicated target/preview_logs/ files via Start-Process redirection; added finite timeout to harness, preventing parent pipe EOF blocking.
